test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The marked price of an AC is Rs. 36800. The shopkeeper offers an off season discount of 11 percent on it. The selling price of the AC is:
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of AC = Rs. 36800

Discount = 11%

**Concept:**

Selling price = Marked price - Discount

**Solution:**

⇒ Selling price = Marked price × (1 - Discount %)

⇒ Selling price = 36800 × (1 - 11%)

⇒ Selling price = 36800 × 0.89

⇒ Selling price = Rs. 32752

**Therefore, the selling price of the AC is Rs. 32752.**
